0022600096.text: The Magic (0-1, one game back in the Southeast and 11th in the East) are at home looking for their first win of the season, while the Timberwolves (1-0, 0.5 games back in the Northwest and 7th in the West) are coming off a road victory. Orlando is without Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Magic won both matchups in 2025-26, including a 132-120 win in Orlando on April 8, 2026.
